scientific_question: Can a deployment-visible one-sided temporal innovation prior preserve sparse-view gradients that all frozen static global quadratic spatial priors failed to preserve?
role: post-open private controlled virtual-BOST temporal mechanism diagnostic; not real experimental pairing, not a learned method, and not a deployment or resource result
physical_hypothesis: The remaining five-camera gradient tail may come from reconstructing every time independently. Penalizing the change from the immediately previous observation-derived reconstruction in coefficient L2 preserves inherited spatial edges while current observations determine the innovation.

new_data_boundary.senior_instruction: generate two-component 2D displacement fields from the executable 3D density field and camera positions
new_data_boundary.historical_pairing_status: the old real 2D-to-3D correspondence is unavailable and is not inferred
new_data_boundary.claim_boundary: all v163 observations are simulated by the frozen straight-ray BOS proxy; real_bost remains false

frozen_predecessor.closed_family: static global quadratic spatial H1, fractional Sobolev, diagonal geometry H1, and full-tensor geometry H1

source_semantics.density_output: first TorchScript output is the reconstructed density field; require finite values only and apply no clipping or offset
source_semantics.synthetic_pairing: camera-field pairing and two-component observations are generated by code for the controlled virtual proxy; no true experiment pairing is inferred
source_semantics.source: direct clarification from the supervising senior, frozen before v163 results

inputs.models: the same nine CPU-adapted TorchScript models sealed by v157-v162
inputs.calibrations: the same thirteen nine-camera JSON files sealed by v157-v162

representation.field_subspace: zero-mean orthonormal DCT 16x8x8 excluding the constant coefficient
representation.initial_anchor: at t=0 use the frozen isotropic H1 fixed-0.03 reconstruction because no previous deployed state exists
representation.later_state_equation: for t_i>0 solve (G + alpha_i I)c_i = q_i + alpha_i c_(i-1), where G=A_B^T A_B and q_i=A_B^T y_i
representation.previous_state: the immediately previous primary reconstruction for the same model, calibration, and active-camera set; never truth or a separately selected candidate
representation.time_scaling: alpha_i = 0.03 * median_positive_eigenvalue(G) * 0.25/(t_i-t_(i-1)); this is the fixed piecewise-linear action scaling of an integrated squared temporal derivative
representation.zero_mass_or_missing_state: forbidden; all four ordered times must exist, otherwise execution is inconclusive
representation.permutation_contract: camera-row reordering leaves G, q, the prior state, and every reconstructed coefficient unchanged within 1e-12 relative
representation.variable_cardinality: the same recurrence is rebuilt independently for the fixed 5-, 7-, and 9-camera active sets
representation.forbidden_variants: no future frame, bidirectional smoothing, truth state, reset, fallback, coefficient clipping, norm clipping, temporal extrapolation, transport warp, learned transition, alternative time scaling, alternative anchor, per-sample selector, or post-result multiplier

regularization.geometry_scale: median eigenvalue of G above max(G) times 1e-12
regularization.static_l2_control: uses the same alpha_i as the primary at every time but a zero prior; at t=0 it uses alpha=0.03*scale

metrics: p50/p90-higher/worst by time, arm, and camera count
primary coefficient recurrence residual and camera-permutation difference

cost_accounting.geometry_setup: 1023 exact nine-camera A-equivalent basis projections per calibration; all camera subsets, models, times, and arms reuse sealed geometry
cost_accounting.primary_online_after_geometry_cache: one reduced exact A-transpose equivalent for current q, one reduced exact A equivalent for the final current projection, and one stored 1023-vector previous state
cost_accounting.resource_claim: forbidden until a later fresh-process wall and whole-pipeline RSS gate

independent_recomputation.physics: rebuild camera rays and sparse operators with the independent v156 numerical path
independent_recomputation.basis: analytic cosine products rather than scipy multidimensional inverse-DCT basis construction
independent_recomputation.solver: scipy.linalg.eigh spectral reconstruction for static systems and direct Cholesky recurrence for the temporal primary; do not import formal recurrence helpers
independent_recomputation.sequence: rebuild every model-calibration-camera sequence in ordered time using only independently generated observations and the prior independent primary coefficient vector
required_comparisons: all 1404 formal and independent primary coefficient vectors
frozen v162 H1 and CGLS rows and summaries

decision_order: Any input, source-semantics, operator, basis, sequence, density, stationarity, residual, accounting, historical-control, permutation, or independent-recomputation failure makes v163 inconclusive.
Only the one-sided previous-primary L2 innovation with fixed multiplier 0.03 and frozen time scaling is primary; no alternative prior, time model, or multiplier may replace it after results.

The primary passes only if every one of the twelve time-by-camera strata passes all absolute gates, each nine-camera stratum satisfies parent no-harm, and the formerly failed t=0.75 five-camera gradient p90 is strictly lower than the frozen H1 value.
If the static-L2 control also passes all twelve strata, temporal persistence is not credited as the explanation and a predictor is not authorized from this diagnostic alone.
A valid primary failure closes the current one-sided coefficient-persistence mechanism and does not authorize temporal tuning, a larger model, or GPU rescue.

A valid primary pass with static-L2 failure establishes only controlled virtual-BOST temporal-reference headroom and authorizes a separately frozen minimal CPU observation-only predictor diagnostic; it is not real BOST, external generalization, or a resource result.
